# 00000004283

**English.** Definition: The Baer-Specker group is the direct product of countably many copies of the integer group. Conjecture: Its automorphism group is generated by elementary matrices together with an explicit table of column symmetries, the minimal cardinality of the table is 2 to the aleph_0, and the generating table has no redundant elements. (minimal generating table of BS automorphisms)

**中文。** 定义：Baer–Specker 群指整数群的 ℵ₀ 次直积。猜想：其自同构群由初等矩阵与列对称的显式表生成,表的最小基数为 2 的 ℵ₀ 次幂,且生成表无冗余元。（BS 自同构最小生成表）
